summary: The patch addresses the specific issue of deleting an index_together when there is a unique_together on the same fields, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch assumes that the constraints for index_together and unique_together are distinct, which may not always be the case. This could lead to incorrect deletion of constraints that are shared between index_together and unique_together.
The patch does not include additional tests to verify that the changes do not introduce regressions or unexpected behavior in other scenarios involving index_together and unique_together.
